_comment: Externally-gathered evidence for one submission, keyed by checklist item id.
Eleven of the fifteen items are decided against sources this tool does not carry:
commercial registries, the supplier-registry and development-bank exclusion lists, the staff
register, HR records, and signed counterparty declarations. Whoever gathers
them writes them here. An item absent from this file is reported as
'not resolved' with the reason stated — never as clean.
'triggers' on any item are the structural escalations the gatherer observed.
They must be drawn from that item's escalate_on list in config/checklist.example.yaml;
anything else is ignored. No trigger is ever a confidence score.

3._note: A match is the correct result while an exclusion is active, not a bug. See config/checklist.example.yaml item 3. The CO determines eligibility to participate; the system reports status.

5._note: A code in high_risk_default is high-risk per SOP-3.7 s4.1.

attestation._note: Signed last, after items 13 and 14 are resolved and the conflictscan report is read. Left unsigned here so the example shows the 'flagged' state.
